stories.title: Token Schema, TTL, and Status Contract
stories.description: Define canonical token schema (hash, issued_at, expires_at, status, scope, rotation_parent_id) and TTL policy contract for GPTReader, including MongoDB index strategy for expiration and status queries.

stories.title: Core Validation Engine (Expire + Revoke + Scope)
stories.description: Implement validation middleware/library enforcing expiration, revocation status, and scope checks for every GPTReader request, using constant-time hash comparison.

stories.title: Rotation Workflow with Overlap Window
stories.description: Implement secure rotation flow: issue new token, link lineage, mark prior token as rotating, enforce short overlap window, and finalize prior token revocation.
stories.evidence: GAP: Rotation not present; required by BL-0.1.4-002 for security hardening

stories.title: Token Management Endpoints (Issue/Revoke/Status)
stories.description: Expose internal Azure Function endpoints for token issuance, revocation, and status lookup, ensuring no plaintext tokens are persisted or returned after creation.

stories.title: Lifecycle Tests and GPTReader Integration
stories.description: Add unit and integration tests validating expiration, rotation overlap behavior, revocation enforcement, and end-to-end GPTReader request rejection for invalid tokens.
